title: Configure ShortRun benchmark defaults
api_or_output: BenchmarkDotNet Job.ShortRun defaults for all current harnesses

acceptance.description: Use BenchmarkDotNet Job.ShortRun as default for tree/input experiment and central benchmark entry points, honoring explicit later CLI job choices. Preserve actual workload semantics and historical measurement reports.

Build all three harnesses, preserve experiment correctness/allocation checks and bootstrap benchmark help; confirm a bounded representative run reports the ShortRun job. Do not rerun the full previous matrices or rewrite their historical job evidence.
Record actual tested implementation revision, commands and outputs plus task validation; future assignments receive user-selected ShortRun convention, with measurement limitations stated honestly.

handoff.summary: User requested benchmarks run with ShortRun to limit duration. Ordered harness configuration change preserves completed measurements.
